limitations: Scores are provisional browser judgments: A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, with null dimensions excluded.
The authorized threshold is not met: numerous screens and components have A below 9, and several have F below 9.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied evidence; content outside an initial viewport is not treated as unreachable when browser scrolling and reachability are reported.
Runtime results were supplied by the user and were not independently rerun; screenshots alone do not establish keyboard behavior, persistence, accessible semantics or recovery.
Only attached still images and chronological filmstrips were visually assessed; no video was watched, and filmstrip sampling is not a frame-rate measurement.
The reported isolated browser timing results support browser performance, while visible background settling remains a separate continuity concern.
Some enlarged captures are visibly scrolled beneath fixed headers; these establish the displayed crop, not permanent loss of the forecast or title.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, notifications and native performance remain deferred without deductions solely for that boundary.
Connected Circles behavior, actual billing and native sharing outcomes are not demonstrated; offline, simulated and mocked states are assessed only within their stated scope.
Synthetic reading and stress-test wording is treated as fixture content, not a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive quality.
Painted lighting, contact shadows and foreground overlap are visible, but independent layer architecture and true parallax cannot be established from these images.
Repeated novice-use evidence is absent, so these grades do not certify exemplary usability or full/native 9–10 performance.
topFixes: Improve centered long-form reading with distinct question, answer, assumption and source groups while preserving every word.
Compact 200% check-in, profile and disclosure layouts so task controls sit closer to the content they affect.
Coordinate room-background settling with foreground content arrival, especially Home-to-Approach and destination transitions.
Separate primary commitments, disclosures and secondary navigation more clearly within the wood-and-parchment material system.
Strengthen pressed-state feedback and long-field scroll cues without adding more decorative texture.
Improve manual invitation-link copying with a dedicated selectable field and clearer wrapping.
